transcript.text: hotpoint SA2 oven not heatin on fan, grill ok. wat does SA2 mean??

SA2 is simply Hotpoint's model series code for this cooker. Regarding the fan oven not heating while the grill works: on many older ovens like yours, if the clock has lost power or been reset, the programmer defaults to an 'auto' mode which stops all heating until you set the time and switch it to manual. Was the clock flashing or showing a timer symbol (like a hand) before you tried to use it, and have you since set the time manually? If it was already set correctly in manual mode, then we will need to check if the fan oven element itself has failed.
clock is set n its in manual, display just shows the time no flashing. fan at the back isnt spinning tho, just a low hum

Since the clock is set correctly and you are in manual mode, we can rule out the programmer. The low hum from the back suggests the motor is trying to run but struggling (which could mean a seized bearing) or simply that current is flowing to a failed heating element. To tell these apart safely: please switch off the oven at the wall and let it cool down completely. Then, reach in and try to spin the fan blade by hand. If it feels stiff or won't turn, the motor is likely seized. If it spins freely but there is still no heat when you turn it on, the heating element has probably failed.
ok isolated it at the cooker switch n let it cool. fan blade is very stiff by hand, feels gritty. also had a slight hot smell from the back once, not now

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. The gritty stiffness and the earlier hot smell confirm that the fan motor bearings have seized. As this involves removing the rear oven panel and dealing with mains wiring connections inside the cavity, I recommend calling an engineer to fit the new part safely.
